paper.title: KG-RAG: Enhancing GUI Agent Decision-Making via Knowledge Graph-Driven Retrieval-Augmented Generation
paper.central_claim: KG-RAG converts incomplete App UI Transition Graphs into an intent-keyed vector database via intent-guided LLM search, and retrieval from it improves GUI-agent success and efficiency (75.8% SR vs AutoDroid 66.9% on DroidTask/GPT-4; plug-and-play for MobileAgent-v2 and UI-TARS; transfers to HarmonyOS/web/desktop). Two new benchmarks (KG-Android-Bench, KG-Harmony-Bench) are also contributed.

signatures.object: Per-app offline knowledge base: (intent embedding -> summarised UI trajectory).
signatures.information: Offline: UTG from automated exploration (xTester, 1h/8h), screenshots of nodes, VLM + LLM. No test-task labels are said to be used.
signatures.operation: VLM infers intents per screen; LLM splits each into milestones; batched BFS over UTG scored by LLM milestone-completion logits (progress score, proximity score tie-break), pruned by threshold; top trajectories summarised and stored.
signatures.conditions: UTG coverage of the app; per-app DB; logged-out screens only.
signatures.feedback: LLM logit scoring of milestone completion (self-generated), no execution verification beyond the UTG edges having been traversed.
signatures.selection_rule: Progress score threshold + beam top-K preferring shorter paths.
signatures.persistence: Vector DB per app, built once offline.
signatures.later_use: Online top-K cosine retrieval by task embedding; retrieved trajectory enters the agent context.
signatures.claimed_effect: SR +8.9 and steps 4.49 -> 4.10 vs AutoDroid; plug-in gains for two agents.
signatures.failure_boundary: UTG cost 1-8h per app; per-app DB; coverage; retrieval embedding choice matters (E023).

gap.author_gap: LLM GUI agents lack app-specific knowledge; UTGs are underused because of poor extraction and inefficient integration.
gap.checked_gap: Plausible and illustrated by deep navigation paths (Fig 1), but quantification of how much failure is due to missing navigation knowledge vs perception/grounding is absent. The comparison to AutoDroid is the only direct neighbour test; locally pinned memory work (AWM, SkillWeaver) is not compared.
lineage: AutoDroid (Wen et al. 2024): UTG offline + LLM online, cited as most relevant
gap.lineage_note: AWM and SkillWeaver are web-agent memories published before this paper; KG-RAG states no prior approach uses a structured KG but never compares to them (E028).
gap.closest_adjacent: AutoDroid for UTG memory; AWM for experience-derived workflow retrieval.
gap.residue: Per-app construction cost, coverage, validity of LLM-scored paths, evaluation breadth.
gap.stakes: Mobile agents on unfamiliar apps with deep navigation.
gap.method_response: Pre-compute intent-labelled paths offline so the online agent retrieves rather than explores.
gap.remaining_gap: Unseen apps and unseen tasks relative to the DB; judged success definition; reliability of LLM-scored trajectories.
unresolved: How much of the gain comes from the DB vs more app information in context (no equal-information control)

assessment.strongest_supported_claim: With a same-app, offline-built, intent-keyed trajectory DB, an LLM agent attains higher single-run success and fewer steps than AutoDroid on DroidTask and than its own no-DB variant for two agents on a handful of apps; the evidence does not cover unseen apps, validated judges, or uncertainty.
assessment.retention: Retained knowledge is the offline DB: before (no DB) -> proposal (VLM intents + LLM-scored BFS) -> selection (progress threshold, top-K) -> persisted (vector DB per app) -> later tasks (cosine retrieval) -> gain (SR/steps vs no-DB). Not self-improving across tasks (DB fixed before test); no rejection data or selection precision reported.

G.reason: Real limitation (deep app navigation, UTG underuse) with AutoDroid as named neighbour, but no quantified residue, and the pinned memory neighbours (AWM, SkillWeaver) are not addressed; novelty claim unchecked.

M.reason: Offline intent->milestone->scored-BFS->DB->retrieval is a coherent route to precomputed navigation knowledge, but the key assumption that LLM-scored paths are correct and that retrieval is the active ingredient is untested, and the integration with agent prompts is undescribed.

X.reason: Algorithms 1-3 are now readable and the DB structure is clear, but thresholds, step size, depth, K, prompts, xTester internals and how retrieved paths enter MobileAgent-v2/UI-TARS are missing; selection precision of stored paths is not given.

E.measurement.reason: SR and DA are named, but who/what decides success and decision correctness is never stated; benchmark task counts conflict (over 200 vs 300); no checker or human validation.

E.causality.reason: Same-agent with/without KG-RAG contrast, two backbones for AutoDroid, KG-construction model and embedding ablations and extraction-time sweep exist; missing equal-information baseline, intent-guided search ablation, comparison to other memory methods; some headline text overclaims (E012).

E.holdout.reason: DB built on the exact test apps; transfer is across platforms of the same app; no unseen-app, unseen-task analysis between VLM-generated intents and test tasks; logged-out screens only.

E.statistics.reason: About 10-15 tasks per cell, single run, no intervals; saturation and +40 claims rest on 10-task cells; Table 7/8 numbers not reconciled.

E.cost.reason: Offline extraction time is measured against accuracy (Table 11) and per-app limits are stated; online retrieval latency, LLM search cost and tokens not reported.
